creatures.description: Lives deep underground or in dense forest, manipulating the surrounding area with Pneuma to build mazes it hunts in. Intelligence comparable to a child.
creatures.name: Minotaur
creatures.talent_effect: Passively gains +x to all rolls where x is the number of opponents. Can activate to vanish into the environment, triggering a contested Deftness roll; on success opponents become Rattled and it becomes Obscured until successfully attacked.

creatures.description: A person-sized serpent as old as the Clans, dwelling in deep caves and quarries. Its stone diet lets its skin take on enhanced properties of the rock it eats.
creatures.name: Gorgon
creatures.talent_effect: A two turn attack: coils around the target to Bind it, then injects a hardening venom that solidifies over 3 rounds, killing them. Resistible with strong enough Pneuma or medical supplies.

creatures.description: A naturally occurring defence system for caves of compressed Pneumatic energy called Void Shards. Its strength scales with the concentration of shards it guards.
creatures.name: Alkalym
creatures.talent_effect: Charges for a turn, then fires a Pneumatic beam laced with Terra Toxin that can hit multiple targets. If damage exceeds the target's Pluck they begin to solidify over 3 turns, killing them.

creatures.description: A grotesque amalgamation of gorgon, takdyl and siren. The siren head lures prey, the gorgon tail petrifies it, and the takdyl torso makes it fast and durable.
creatures.name: Chimera
creatures.talent_effect: Gains 2 Talents from either the Gorgon, Takdyl or Siren.

creatures.description: A Forged-built hybrid species, made to hold the ecosystem of Heirloom Island together after The Blue Scream drove its avian life toward extinction.
creatures.name: Mechanicrow

creatures.description: A scavenger evolved by feeding on the Pneuma-soaked corpses of the Battle of Canid Grace. Shifts between beast and humanoid shape at will.
creatures.name: Harpy
creatures.talent_effect: Takes the shape of whatever it last consumed Pneuma from. If it attacks a player it gains access to their Trait for xd6 rounds where x is its Threat Level. Main skill becomes Tenacity when unable to fly.

creatures.description: Harpies that fed on other harpies in desperation. Reptilian and avian both, with two sets of dragon-like wings and extra mouths that ingest prey and expel toxins.
creatures.name: Takdyl
creatures.talent_effect: Spends a Support action vomiting out impurities, removing x status effects and granting immunity to them for x rounds where x is its Threat Level. Anything touching the expelled fluid gains the effects instead. Main skill becomes Deftness while airborne.

creatures.description: Takdyls that fed on their own kind, roughly triple the size, with wings and eyes numbering as many as it has consumed. Can manifest mouths anywhere on its body.
creatures.name: Wyvern
creatures.talent_effect: On entering combat its main skill becomes the type and value of the opponent's lowest skill, and re-targets as opponents leave. Can activate to raise that skill by xd6 where x is its Threat Level.

creatures.description: The merging of a drowned soul and a drowned animal. Generally non-aggressive, capable of telepathic speech and of shaping water into a humanoid form while on land.
creatures.name: Kelpie
creatures.talent_effect: On taking lethal damage it shifts to a liquid state instead and gains +x to movement. Triggers x times where x is its Threat Level. Main skill becomes Deftness in water.

creatures.description: A soul drowned maliciously and reincarnated in rage. Sees the Color of the Core and hunts those with ill intent by singing them to sleep.
creatures.name: Siren
creatures.talent_effect: Sings, rolling 1d20 + Wit. Anyone whose Pluck is exceeded becomes Bound and hallucinates their heart's desire, taking xd6 Pneumatic damage at the end of their turn where x is its Threat Level. Reaching zero Pneuma this way kills the target.

creatures.description: Titans cast out of the celestial realm for their destructive nature. Adapts in both personality and physicality to the waters it inhabits.
creatures.name: Kraken
creatures.talent_effect: Passively refracts elemental energy: against a Pneumatic or Trait attack, roll xd6 where x is its Threat Level and subtract that from the damage. Can activate to blend in via a contested Wit check, becoming Obscured until successfully damaged.

creatures.description: One of the original Celestial Beasts, formed from the energy lost each time a target falls to the Pyre Trait. Killing one only scatters it into ash and a new egg.
creatures.name: Phoenix
creatures.talent_effect: Completely immune to Pyre attacks and statuses, transmuting that damage into bonus health and damage on its next attack. Can activate to turn any Trait based attack into Pyre for 1d6 + x rounds where x is its Threat Level.

creatures.description: A Titan created as the Phoenix's predator to balance the Celestial ecosystem. Composed almost entirely of Null energy.
creatures.name: Magnus Dragon
creatures.talent_effect: Nullifies the Trait of anything it bites for x rounds where x is its Threat Level unless the target passes a contested Composure roll. Anything killed by this bite cannot be resurrected.

creatures.description: Souls that were people or wildlife before Ashecorps' influence touched them in death. Individually weak, they travel in threes and call for more.
creatures.name: The Afflicted
creatures.talent_effect: Spends a turn calling for help; each consecutive call adds 1d6/2 Afflicted of the same or lower level to the fight.

creatures.description: The failed emergence of an attempted Haunted creation. Formless, it consumes people who resemble its fractured memories and takes on their attributes.
creatures.name: Fleshspinner
creatures.talent_effect: A two turn attack: bites the target, siphoning xd6 Pneuma where x is its Threat Level, then gains x of the target's techniques and raises its main skill by half the target's corresponding skill.

creatures.description: Spirits made of the missing parts of history, cursed to wander. They drain the Pneuma of anyone nearby, usually before a fight can begin at all.
creatures.name: Zeitghast
creatures.talent_effect: Passively steals xd6 Pneuma from x targets where x is its Threat Level. Can activate to steal xd6 + x maximum Pneuma from one target, disabling the passive for x rounds. Reaching zero Pneuma in this fight kills the target.

creatures.description: A Damned Deity under Ashecorps' command, known to mortals as Ban, the Greed God. Sacrificed his own kingdom for a Dominion the size of his throne room, in which he controls gravity.
creatures.name: Kah'clth-Kahban
creatures.talent_effect: At the start of combat rolls xd6 where x is its Threat Level; that result is subtracted from the effectiveness of any opponent action involving major movement. Can activate to make an opponent Winded, removing the previous debuff; used on a Winded opponent it Binds them instead, and on a Bound opponent it doubles the next damage they take.
